title: Search settings that repeat
heading: Stop on Solutions, Not Seconds, When a Result Must Repeat
cases: the strategy, metaheuristic and solution count named in the call are the ones the parameters hold
two runs with a fixed strategy, guided local search and a solution limit give the same routes and cost
a metaheuristic named without a solution count still gets one, the default of 200
no parameters carry a time limit, so no printed result depends on the machine's speed
greedy descent with no count named keeps the unlimited default, since it stops at its local minimum by itself
